A red star marks the peak on the Overall Average chart.","description":"A grid of 12 line charts, each with an Accuracy y-axis and an x-axis running from 50 to 260. Lines have pale shaded areas beneath them. The blue MATH REASONING section contains AIME 2024, AIME 2025, Olympiad Bench, Minerva, Math 500, AMC 2023, and Math Average. The orange CODE REASONING section contains HumanEval+, MBPP+, LiveCodeBench, and Code Average. The green OVERALL PERFORMANCE section contains Overall Average. The y-axis ranges differ by chart, so the apparent heights should be compared using each chart’s own scale. AIME 2024 fluctuates sharply, with a peak near 0.20 around x=200; AIME 2025 is also irregular and mostly lower, with a peak around 0.13 near x=130. Olympiad Bench remains relatively steady around 0.36–0.40 after starting near 0.29. Minerva varies around 0.32–0.38, peaking near x=130. Math 500 is the highest math series, rising from about 0.63 to a plateau around 0.72–0.75 before ending slightly lower. AMC 2023 fluctuates substantially, reaching about 0.62 near x=170 and falling to a low near 0.38 around x=250. HumanEval+ stays comparatively steady around 0.70–0.74. MBPP+ rises to about 0.70 near x=125 and then generally declines to around 0.67. LiveCodeBench trends upward overall from about 0.24 to the upper 0.20s, with fluctuations. Math Average rises to a peak near 0.39 around x=130, then fluctuates and ends near 0.34. Code Average is nearly flat around 0.55, with small variations. Overall Average starts near 0.42, rises to a marked peak near 0.47 around x=130, and then fluctuates mostly around 0.45–0.46; a red star marks that peak.
